prompts.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Output ONE finished standalone ClaudeBuddy promotional image. This is a single deliverable, NOT a contact sheet, moodboard, brand board, multi-panel overview of deliverables, or collage. Do NOT include filenames, dimensions, section labels, export annotations, or framing from the reference board. Fill the entire canvas with this ONE design.
Input image 1 is a STYLE REFERENCE BOARD ONLY: borrow its typography, palette, restrained visual hierarchy and mood; never reproduce the board or any collection of assets. Input image 2 is the APPROVED CRAB LOGO: preserve its recognizable exact paper-cut crab identity, warm coral body, curved raised claws, round dark eyes with cream glints, cheeks, gentle smile and layered paper details.
Art direction: exceptionally premium, classy, warm and friendly. Quiet editorial sophistication and careful craftsmanship. Muted charcoal-slate approximately #35404a, darker charcoal #272c31, warm ivory/cream approximately #f2e6c9, coral approximately #f17b60. Subtle depth and extremely restrained texture. No glow, neon, flashy gradients or heavy drop shadows. Generous negative space, elegant balanced proportions, precise alignment. Logo mascot is a charming accent; do not make it gigantic or toy-like.
Typography: closely match the reference board's refined CLASSIC BOOK SERIF for the ClaudeBuddy name and feature headline: graceful bracketed serifs, moderate stroke contrast, elegant proportions, optical kerning, warm character. More like a carefully typeset literary book cover than chunky Cooper-style or bubbly lettering. Pair with a quiet, light/regular humanist sans-serif for the supporting copy. Flat ivory type. No dimensional/embossed lettering. Keep text very legible at target size, disciplined line lengths and hierarchy.
Brand name exactly "ClaudeBuddy", one word, capital C and B. Independent companion for Claude usage observations, configured peak hours and public outage status. No official Anthropic marks, affiliation claims, live monitoring claims, quota increases, invented promises, watermark, sparkle corner symbols, decorative clutter, extra copy or buttons. Keep all text and crab claws safely inside margins.

prompts.name: usage-showcase
prompts.details: Create ONLY the 1280 by 800 Usage feature showcase. Premium dark slate editorial layout with refined serif headline on left and two compact, readable light/dark popup ILLUSTRATIONS on right, like the board's usage panel but enlarged to fill this standalone image. Small crab and ClaudeBuddy wordmark as branding. Exact headline: "Your last reading." then "At a glance." Supporting copy exactly: "Captured five-hour usage, reset times and reading age." Popup illustrations show fictional "Active workspace", "24% used", "5h quota", "Resets in 2h", "Updated just now", and a small "Off peak" service indicator, with a simple usage progress bar. Do not show chat messages, token counts, weekly usage or big dashboard charts. Caption clearly and legibly: "Illustrative UI · Sample data". Include small "Independent of Anthropic." No other copy.
